caption: The drawing depicts two lace designs on a beige or light tan paper background. The primary object, positioned in the upper center, is an ornate collar with a teardrop-shaped central opening and a wide outer edge featuring a scalloped border. The collar is decorated with a repeating pattern of delicate, leafy branches and flowers, all drawn in fine gray pencil lines. The scalloped edges are accented with small looped details following the perimeter. Below the main collar design, there is a smaller rectangular lace trim, also with a scalloped edge and delicate floral motifs. The overall composition is vertically oriented, with ample blank space surrounding the lace designs. There is a small brown stain on the right side of the paper and faint text in the lower right corner.
title: Embroidered Linen Collar
